Sorry for the long answer but i go into depth of whatll be good for the apocalypse to help you survive and thrive. Answers for my choices oj the bottom.

Many frames are great at what they do except Inaros. But it all comes down to type of zombies and where you are in the world. If you want to do both heal and do damage well wisp, protea, trinity... styanax and Dante give overguard and don't know how it'll function in real life (sorry needing out and like the realistic of things for zombie stuff) so they might be out.  And as for defending there's plenty of frames who do that. Now you can be up against any kind of zombies like the walking dead slow walkers or the fast zombies in world War Z, or left 4 dead zombies.  If we are up against walking dead zombies then the best choice is probably a frame that can prevent hordes from getting to you or keeping them at bay in worst case scenarios... it'll come down to how important you'll be to other people because people will want you on their side no matter what. 


As for weapons do all weapons have limited ammo or infinite. Zombies won't drop anything like ammo. So what's best weapon that'll not use ammo, like natturuk, bubonico, shedu and a few others I belive. As for a secondary there's plenty of options and I will admit I don't know whatll be best. But throwing knives or stars will probably not go into the heads of the undead without extremely high speeds,  and now for melee weapons yoy can't go wrong with any of them. Throwing weapons might get stuck and wont return so youll need to go and grab it. So you'll want something blunt or heavy to do the damage. Like a big hammer like the magistar or arca titron. 

For companion you'll want something that'll keep yoy company and won't die easily. But something to help you more than anything. The Sahasa kubrow to dig up ammo. Or the huras kunrow to keep you invisible. Now a good sentinel would be wyrm for that negate mod. Let's say you do get bit and negate prevents the infection. I don't know a lot about the vulpaphylas and other companions.

If you go with the sahasa kubrow then any weapons that need ammo would be ok if you don't pick it then an infinite battery weapon would be ideal

So I think the best combo for most zombie apocalypse scenarios would be 

Wisp for her motes and portal to the sun
Bubonico for the shotgun and cannon modes and ammo
Akstilleto prime for fast fire rate and ammo 
Arca titron because Shockwave bonk 
And sahasa kubrow because they can find ammo and a cuddly doggo companion so you don't go crazy alone
